newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH APRIL EXPORTS THOUGH PORTS UP 18 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH APRIL EXPORTS THOUGH PORTS UP 18 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Finnish exports through ports rose 18.0 percent year-on-year in April and paper exports rose 17.2 percent, the Board of Navigation said on Monday.

Total April exports through ports rose 497,644 tonnes to 3.25 million tonnes, lifting the January-April total by 1.77 million to 12.05 million tonnes, a 17.2 percent year-on-year increase, the board said.
April paper exports through ports rose 115,465 tonnes to 788,217 tonnes, and the January-April total was up 489,202 tonnes at 3.02 million, up 19.4 percent year-on year, it said.
Imports through ports increased 15.8 percent year-on-year in April to 3.20 million tonnes while January-April imports were 9.8 percent higher at 11.01 million tonnes, the board said.
